name: cyclic jump acceleration algorithm
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过跨越多个荷载循环加速疲劳演化计算的方法。
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道系统的长期疲劳演化计算，根据局部荷载循环中的损伤变化趋势外推后续状态，减少需要显式计算的循环数，以加快数值求解。

complete_examples.text: The cost time of fatigue analysis is 78 s and 3.57 hours through the cyclic jump acceleration algorithm and original increment-by-increment method, respectively.
The above results indicate that the cyclic jump acceleration algorithm in the fatigue analysis of concrete is high-efficient and credible.
